## 2026-05-27 04:14 Atlas Gate Cache / Fast Fallback Refix

## 2026-05-27 02:23 Atlas Turnstile Root Iframe Fix

This slice investigated the user report that the public graph page stayed on `进入图谱前先过一次验证` and verification did not complete. ## 2026-05-23 22:48 Weekly Mini-Program Retry Load Backend Hotfix

This backend-only hotfix targets the observed online-client behavior where the home page can load if the user waits, but repeated reload taps make loading less reliable. It did not upload a new mini-program frontend and did not submit WeChat review.

- Backend deployed and remotely effective: CloudRun `weekly-api-065`, public API base `https://weekly-api-255880-4-1371956557.sh.run.tcloudbase.com`, active flow `100%`.
- Resource package baseline preserved: registry129 package `D:\downstream_results\stage7_rewrite\longrun\WEEKLY_ACTIVITY_MINIPROGRAM_API_20260522_REGISTRY129_SYNC_1734`, manifest/package `196`, default current `121`, `lookbackDays=1` current `195`.
- Root cause: the current client starts home loading at `8%` while waiting for `current/cities/dates`; it does not cancel or ignore older in-flight loads, so repeated reload taps create overlapping request groups and can let older slow/failing requests race newer successful loads.
- Backend mitigation: `/weekly/manifest`, `/weekly/current`, `/weekly/cities`, and `/weekly/dates` now ignore `_ts` in short cache keys, use in-memory JSON cache, coalesce concurrent identical requests, and gzip public JSON responses while leaving CloudBase `callContainer` responses un-gzipped.
- Online cache probe: `/weekly/current?limit=100&lookbackDays=1&_ts=a` `MISS` `323ms`; `_ts=b` same logical request `HIT` `71ms`; both total `195`.
- Simulated reload burst: `12/12` current requests `200`, first `MISS`, following requests `HIT`.
- Verification: CloudRun service tests `61/61` pass; mini-program tests `42/42` pass; production smoke `ok=true`, blockers `[]`; pressure `7534` requests / `0` failures, concurrency `16` p95 `64ms`.
- Release Guardian note: `GateMode=current-package` overall remains `ok=false` only because `daily_queue_cached_fallback_usable` expects `body_backfill_ok`; online current probe, frontend real data probe, source hash/source map, visible URL, and mini-program tests are green.
- Evidence: `reports\WEEKLY_MINIPROGRAM_RETRY_LOAD_BACKEND_HOTFIX_20260523.md`; deploy report `tools\stage7_rewrite\reports\cloudrun_direct_deploy_retry_cache_singleflight_20260523\cloudrun_direct_api_deploy_report.json`; smoke `tools\stage7_rewrite\reports\smoke_weekly_retry_cache_singleflight_20260523`; pressure `tools\stage7_rewrite\reports\pressure_weekly_retry_cache_singleflight_20260523`.

## 2026-05-22 02:12 Atlas Profile Canonical-Alias Fullness Fix

This slice fixes the observed `/atlas/graph` "全量档案太少" issue for high-volume venue / org profiles such as `OIL`.

- Root cause: the profile API was full only for the exact entity name. For `OIL`, the UI showed `entities.name='OIL'` counts (`9,005` entity rows / `8,714` source articles) but did not canonical-merge aliases and evidence surfaces such as `OIL油`, `OIL Club`, `OIL CLUB`, `深圳OIL`, `source_account='OIL油'`, and `events.place='OIL...'`.
- Fix: `services\weekly_activity_cloudrun\src\stage7AtlasSqliteStore.mjs` now expands venue/org/label-style profile terms through bounded canonical aliases across `entities.name`, `articles.source_account`, and `events.place`, then builds the profile from the union while keeping source windows capped for public display.

- Noise guard: city-only place labels such as `深圳` are no longer counted as historical venues in the public profile rollup.

## 2026-05-22 01:55 Atlas High-Performance Database Architecture

This slice adds the current database-performance architecture for the DJ-first Atlas serving layer.

- New architecture doc: `docs\ATLAS_HIGH_PERFORMANCE_DATABASE_ARCHITECTURE_20260522.md`.
- Decision: keep full `atlas.sqlite` and recovered raw source URLs private; build public-safe immutable `atlas_serving.sqlite` from the existing repair sidecars and DJ rollups; use DuckDB only for offline analytical build jobs; benchmark Meilisearch only if SQLite FTS5 cannot meet omnibox ranking/latency; benchmark ArcadeDB privately for graph algorithms; reject Kuzu as a production dependency because upstream is archived.
- Current measured bottleneck: graph search seed p95 is already `51 ms`, but full profile p95 is `1,037 ms` on the raw source-window path. The fix is precomputed `dj_profile`, `dj_event`, `dj_relation_rollup`, `dj_venue_rollup`, `dj_org_rollup`, `evidence_ref`, `search_document`, and `graph_window_cache` tables.
- Target public budgets: search p95 `<80 ms`, DJ profile p95 `<120 ms`, graph window p95 `<200 ms`.
- Security boundary: no raw `source_url`, raw HTML path, source DB path, raw JSON, or bulk graph export in the public serving artifact.
- Cost boundary: this is a no-paid-LLM / no-managed-graph-DB architecture. The expensive work runs locally/offline; the Singapore VPS serves only capped read models and optional local search sidecar.

  - adds `x-openclaw-common-env: &openclaw-common-env`.
  - makes each service `environment` merge `<<: *openclaw-common-env`.
  - verified resolved profiles now all include `OPENCLAW_MODE=contract-only`, `OPENCLAW_DB_WRITE_POLICY=disabled`, and `OPENCLAW_CLOUDBASE_UPLOAD_POLICY=disabled`.
- `tools\stage7_rewrite\tests\test_openclaw_docker_compose_profile_config.py`
  - now asserts every resolved profile inherits common policy env.
- `tools\stage7_rewrite\scripts\validate_openclaw_docker_profiles_contract.py`
  - now requires each service block to merge `*openclaw-common-env`.
- `tools\stage7_rewrite\tests\test_validate_openclaw_docker_profiles_contract.py`
  - adds a negative test proving a service missing the common env merge fails static contract.
